messages:
alex: Quick heads-up — planning to enable the partitioned-config toggle for tenant-based batching tonight at 23:00 PST (will unpause EU, APAC waves after 30m). Who can own smoke + rollback?

maria: I can own smoke for infra side. I'll run the synthetic canary and watch indexing throughput + error logs.

dan: I can do the first 30m of post-flip monitoring (latency + 429s). I'll be online 22:50–00:30 PST.

jess: What are the safe-defaults while the toggle ramps? Should we keep fallback route enabled?

alex: Yes — keep fallback route (config.fallback.enabled=true) and circuit-breaker at 0.75. Plan is: wave1 10% tenants, wave2 35%, wave3 100% after green.

leo: Small note: this is a partitioned toggle per-tenant (not global), so we need to watch per-tenant memory growth. I'll add a quick dashboard panel for per-tenant GPU queue length.

maria: Smoke checklist I'll run:
- run synthetic user path (ingest -> query -> kv cache hit)
- confirm p50/p95 token latency < target
- check error-rate < 0.5%
- verify no OOMs in logs

alex: Dan — can you post the flip command you want ops to run? Keep it idempotent.

dan: Sure — using config-api for toggles:
```bash
# enable for tenant wave1 (tenant ids in file)
cat wave1_tenants.txt | xargs -I{} curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $CFG' https://config.internal/v1/toggles/partitioned_batching/enable -d '{"tenant_id":"{}","mode":"on"}'
```

jess: Good. Rollback steps?

maria: Rollback is simple: set the toggle mode back to `off` for affected tenants, disable batching at router if needed, and set circuit-breaker to 1.0 to short-circuit extra retries.

leo: I'll prepare the dashboard links in #eng-platform-monitoring and tag the charts: p50 tokens, p95 tokens, 429 rate, CPU/GPU queue length, mem RSS.

alex: Ownership recap: maria = infra smoke + rollback exec, dan = immediate post-flip observer, leo = dashboards + alert thresholds, jess = fallback route guard. I'll be the deploy lead and call the wave timings.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deployment: partitioned-config toggle — start 2024-03-17T23:00:00-08:00. Creator: alex. Watch channel: #eng-platform. Token: cfg-***.

jess: Can we put an automated patrol check at +10m that runs the synthetic canary and posts a pass/fail? If it fails, auto-pause wave.

dan: Yes — I can push a small job to run the canary and post results to the thread. If failure, we trigger rollback script: `scripts/toggle_rollback.sh wave1`

maria: Alert thresholds I'll set:
- error-rate > 0.8% for 5m -> page on-call SRE
- 429 rate > 2% for 5m -> slack alert and hold next wave
- p95 latency increase > 35% vs baseline -> slack alert

alex: Final timing: 23:00 enable wave1 (10% tenants). Wait 30m and validate. If green, 23:40 enable wave2 (35%). If anything anomalous, abort and rollback to off.

leo: One last thing — some EU tenants have longer sequences; suggest we exclude EU subset from wave2 and stage them in a separate window (+2h). I'll add the tenant list now.

alex: OK sounds good. Tagging attendees: @maria @dan @leo @jess — we'll do a short preflight at 22:45 in this thread. If anyone can't make the window, ping now.

maria: I'll be there.

dan: I'll be there.

jess: On call.

alex: Great — thanks all. I'll post a one-line status here after each wave.
